observations: Two car headlights wrapped in clear plastic film.
The plastic film is crisscrossed and appears to be thin, possibly bubble wrap.
The lenses are clear and show no visible cracks or heavy scratches.
The housing and mounting brackets are visible but not clearly detailed.
A watermark 'LINUS AUTO LIGHT SOLUTION' is present on all photos.
A third headlight unit is partially visible in photo 2, but it is not wrapped.

claims.evidence: The plastic wrapping obscures the ability to verify the authenticity of the part.
No Honda logo or model badge is visible in the photos.
The photos do not show the model badges or compatibility markings.

risks.risk: The plastic wrapping may be thin bubble wrap that will tear or degrade under heat or vibration.
risks.proof: A photo of the headlights with the plastic removed.

risks.risk: The internal bulb sockets or wiring may be broken or missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the back of the headlights showing the bulb sockets.

risks.risk: The lenses may have internal scratches or haze that cannot be seen through the plastic.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the lens surface without the plastic.

proof_requests: Photo of the headlights with the plastic wrapping removed.
Photo of the back of the headlights showing the bulb sockets.
Photo of the front lens surface without the plastic wrap.
Photo of the model badge or part number on the housing.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
